purpose: Teach: 無くなる/しっくり/どうこう/さび/インチキ/かろうじて/よけい/おわり

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんちのおもちゃが無くなるのは寂しいわね
lines.en: Sho, it's sad thinking about losing Grandma's old toys, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm, observant voice. Settling into a tender memory. Speaking gently to invite him to feel safe in sadness. Soft on the final particle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくは新しい学校にしっくりこないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I don't really fit in at my new school.
lines.style: Quiet, careful delivery. The words cost him. Pauses slightly before admitting it. Small, uncertain voice — testing whether it's safe to say.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達のことをどうこう言わないでね
lines.en: Sho, let's not talk badly about your classmates, okay?
lines.style: Gentle redirect, not scolding. Knowing smile underneath. The tone of someone who trusts him to understand without being told why. Soft firmness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくのお気に入りのお皿、さびちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis… my favorite plate got rust on it.
lines.style: Small, deflecting observation. He's circling around something heavier. The words are simple but the tone carries quiet hurt. Matter-of-fact surface, tender underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、インチキおじさんに気をつけてね
lines.en: Sho, be careful of people who aren't what they seem, alright?
lines.style: Protective warmth. Not alarming — just clear. She's watching out for him. Steady, low voice. The kindness of someone who notices what could hurt him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、かろうじて、お祖父ちゃんに会えたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I barely got to see Grandpa.
lines.style: Fragile relief mixed with lingering sadness. He's sharing something precious and fragile. Quiet, almost wondering. The word 'barely' carries weight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、よけいなお買い物はやめましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's not buy things we don't really need, okay?
lines.style: Gentle practical guidance. Not correcting — caring. She's teaching him something about what matters. Warm, steady tone. A soft hand on his shoulder in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、絵本のおわりが、お祖父ちゃんに似てたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… the ending of the picture book… it reminded me of Grandpa.
lines.style: Soft, wondering observation. He's found something that connects him back to his grandfather. The words come slowly, with gentle discovery. Trailing off into quiet understanding.
